data.title: Cadence is a chip stock left behind by the AI boom. Why the CEO says that's a mistake
data.description: Cadence President and CEO Anirudh Devgan said AI is a growth driver, not a threat, as increasingly complex chips drive demand for the company’s design tools.
data.author: Alexa LoMonaco
